resources.string: The current media app could not be opened.
Please grant notification access to enable media controls.

Android notification access lets OnCue show track details and progress, control playback, and reopen your player. It also grants access to notifications. OnCue does not save notification messages or send media data to the developer. See Privacy policy below.

Battery optimization can freeze timestamps and progress, even when the widget is visible. For more reliable updates, allow unrestricted background battery usage in app settings. The setting name varies by device.\n\nThis may increase battery use. OnCue stops periodic timer updates when playback is paused or the screen is off or locked. Optimized remains an option, but updates may freeze.
On the next screen, choose Battery → Unrestricted.
